body:
Hi Alberto,

I want to humbly suggest your take on a module that is similar to the color-harmonizer module in Darktable. [Link](https://discuss.pixls.us/t/new-module-merged-color-harmonizer/56322)
I think it would be a great addition conceptually in the local-edits-tab for ARTraweditor and maybe you have ideas regarding other 'pull-functions'.

Again, thanks for even looking into this!
Cheers,
Bob
title: Module suggestion: Color-harmonizer
